anti_overfitting_rules: No 2026-27 data in any training, evaluation or selection step (no live gate).
Eight seeds per recipe from the first screen (44-51); finalists get at least 8 more seeds (52-59) before any choice.

A child beats its parent only if its primary is lower by more than max(2 x standard error of the difference of seed means, 1% of the parent), it is lower in both 2024-25 and 2025-26, and its 2023-24 guard is not worse by more than that margin (RSV: ED share, same margin in percent). Smaller differences are 'level' and are not pursued.
Prefer changes with a mechanism (nowcast, double counting, data, structure) over continuous tuning; no random hyperparameter searches.
An axis is closed after two rounds without a 'better' child. Combinations only of children that were 'better' on their own.
The release candidate is chosen on seed mixtures of a few recipes, compared with the production mixture refit leak-free on the same seeds; mixture weights are equal, never tuned.

WIS in each state's peak window (target weeks within 2 weeks of its finalized season maximum) is reported for every finalist and mixture (scripts/flu_phase_check.py); a candidate may not be worse there by more than the margin.
